description: This file contains JavaScript code for the SuiteP theme in SuiteCRM, including UI interactions, layout adjustments, sidebar toggling, and event handling.

methods.name: loadSidebar
methods.description: Toggles the sidebar visibility and manages related layout classes and cookies.

methods.name: initFooterPopups
methods.description: Initializes footer dialog popups for 'powered by' and admin options.

methods.name: selectTab
methods.description: Shows the specified tab content and hides others.

methods.name: changeFirstTab
methods.description: Changes the first tab's content based on a clicked element.

methods.name: isUserProfilePage
methods.description: Determines if the current page is a user profile page based on URL parameters.

methods.name: isEditViewPage
methods.description: Checks if the current page is an EditView page.

methods.name: isDetailViewPage
methods.description: Checks if the current page is a DetailView page.

methods.name: refreshListViewCheckbox
methods.description: Updates the checkbox icon state based on whether the checkbox is checked or disabled.
